reported_geometry: For full96, central32 and center4: total/domain-valid sample counts, positive-overlap sample counts, sum/mean/max of bbox contributing weight, and unique positive in-image contributing bbox pixels. All UNKNOWN/nonfinite geometry remains null with original status/reason.

interpretation: Positive bbox overlap is only a necessary footprint condition for the observed coarse bbox to affect raw96, never supportYES, actual part presence or native visibility gold.
